implementation.borrowed_submission_resources: path copied and root descriptor duplicated before task start

implementation.directory_staging_safe_api_access: safe std.fs filesystem operations reject every path operand selecting a reserved staging component before native submission
implementation.directory_staging_foreign_mutation_bound: independent native or foreign mutation is outside staging identity and exactly-once cleanup guarantees; capability confinement remains mandatory
implementation.directory_staging_cleanup: without independent native or foreign mutation: directory creation performs one root-confined unlinkat before every pre-publication terminal acknowledgement and successful rename consumes its staging directory; whole-file publication performs exactly one non-cancellable cleanup after staging creation on failure or success, removing payload if present and then the staging directory before terminal acknowledgement

implementation.filesystem_error_closed_native_mapping: EBADF for a retained filesystem identity maps to std.fs::closed (19)

file_payload_adapter.queued_cancellation: a transfer waiting for admission is removed and finished on its handle serial queue without a native call; an admitted transfer that has not entered its call finishes without it
file_payload_adapter.entered_cancellation: record the event, make no further native call and acknowledge after the call returns
file_payload_adapter.retention: request, buffer, handle and task frame through the native return

implementation.deadline: DispatchSourceTimer followed by the cancellation of the handle engine
implementation.terminal_acknowledgement: final Dispatch I/O handler or root close cleanup handler for Dispatch I/O handles; for file and socket handles the request terminal transition after the last native call returned and root cleanup after the last direct activity
implementation.retention: request and owned buffer or immutable shared owner retained through the final native handler or native call
implementation.child_cleanup_handler: captures no R request and may be deferred until root close
implementation.flush_semantics: Dispatch I/O ordering barrier only; no durability claim
implementation.flush_submission: serialized after terminal acknowledgement of every prior accepted payload operation
implementation.flush_precommit_cancel_deadline: immediate terminal outcome before barrier submission
implementation.payload_during_active_flush: queued in reserved same-direction submission order
implementation.explicit_close_during_active_operation: cancel requests with an earlier submission sequence and wait for native acknowledgement
implementation.close_deadline: cleanup and view release always complete before timed_out publication; a terminal close failure known before start takes precedence
implementation.console_root_lifecycle: runtime-owned roots survive view close/drop; hosted finish drains output and flush barriers, cancels input, waits for acknowledgement, then releases roots
implementation.same_direction_submission_order: reads serialize independently; writes and flushes share one ordered output queue
implementation.queued_cancellation_deadline: terminalize without payload submission, preserve owned buffer or shared owner, acknowledge exactly once and release the next request
implementation.low_level_relative_deadline: runtime payload requests receive an adapter-computed relative timeout; std.fs payload requests pass no native timeout because std_fs_deadline_clock governs their absolute deadline
implementation.std_fs_shared_position_order: std.fs::read, std.fs::write, std.fs::write_all, std.fs::read_at, std.fs::write_all_at, std.fs::seek, std.fs::flush and std.fs::sync share one synchronized FIFO in successful-start submission order
implementation.std_fs_payload_handle: successful std.fs file output materialization creates and owns one payload handle over a duplicated descriptor before file-result publication, a file payload adapter handle for a regular file and a Dispatch I/O STREAM handle for any other file type; materialization failure publishes no file handle, and every payload start only retains that handle
implementation.std_fs_nonappend_positioning: every read and non-append write of a regular file passes the shared logical absolute position, or the explicit offset of a positional operation, as the offset of pread or pwrite on the file payload adapter and never moves the descriptor offset; for any other file type the position is applied with lseek(SEEK_SET) inside dispatch_io_barrier on its STREAM handle; a positional operation leaves the shared logical position unchanged
implementation.std_fs_append_positioning: append writes use write on a regular file and the STREAM handle for any other file type, on a descriptor retaining O_APPEND, select end atomically for each write and do not change the shared read/seek observation position
implementation.std_fs_deadline_clock: std.fs payload operations retain the absolute std.time instant in the mach_continuous_time domain; activation and every Dispatch timer wake recompute the remaining continuous duration and re-arm until the absolute deadline is reached
implementation.std_fs_absolute_deadline: for std.fs payload operations the absolute std.time instant is fixed before task commit, is never converted once into a stored relative timeout and remains effective while waiting in the shared position FIFO and during native I/O
implementation.std_fs_cancellation_deadline_acknowledge: queued cancellation or deadline removes the position reservation before acknowledgement; cancellation before the transfer enters its native call finishes it without that call; cancellation after entry is acknowledged after the call returns, or for a file that is not regular after the final Dispatch I/O handler, and the handle, buffer and task frame are retained until then
implementation.std_fs_explicit_close: std.fs::close_file reserves the handle before task commit, rejects new operations, cancels and drains registered operations, waits for the handle root cleanup that follows the last native activity, propagates its native error and releases its view exactly once
implementation.std_fs_whole_file_read_pipeline: filesystem-lane open, one per-operation RANDOM payload handle over a duplicated descriptor (file payload adapter for a regular file, Dispatch I/O otherwise), filesystem-lane close of the original descriptor, repeated offset-ordered reads and handle root cleanup
implementation.std_fs_whole_file_read_path_policy: std.fs::read_file follows an ordinary path final symbolic link; std.fs::read_file_beneath opens relative to the retained directory with O_RESOLVE_BENEATH and O_NOFOLLOW_ANY and rejects intermediate and final symbolic links
implementation.std_fs_whole_file_read_limit_eof: each read is bounded by the 65536-byte chunk and the remaining limit-plus-one probe; EOF is authoritative, including a one-byte probe when limit is zero; at most limit bytes succeeds and an observed byte beyond limit returns file_too_large
implementation.std_fs_whole_file_read_terminal_acknowle: publish the task terminal outcome only after filesystem-lane close acknowledgement for the original descriptor and the root cleanup of the RANDOM payload handle; every error destroys the partial array before publication

implementation.backend: DNSServiceGetAddrInfo assigned to one private serial Dispatch queue per request
implementation.start_failure_operand_preservation: the complete host byte sequence is copied into immutable task-owned NUL-terminated storage before task commit; every precommit allocation or runtime-stopping failure performs no DNS query and leaves the caller borrow unchanged
implementation.task_local_validation: before native submission the task classifies numeric candidates exactly by colon or decimal-and-dot syntax and otherwise validates ASCII DNS labels, final dot, 63-byte label and 253-byte total limits, with embedded NUL rejected
implementation.numeric_resolution: parse_ip handles numeric candidates without DNS submission; requested-family mismatch returns name_not_found with native code zero
implementation.dns_submission: after task commit and validation DNSServiceGetAddrInfo is submitted without blocking an executor worker; DNSServiceSetDispatchQueue binds callbacks and deallocation to the request serial queue
implementation.result_ordering: accepted v4 and v6 addresses preserve DNSServiceGetAddrInfo callback order, remove duplicates, retain IPv6 scope and receive the requested host-order port; an empty accepted set returns name_not_found
implementation.error_mapping: definitive absence maps to name_not_found, explicitly retryable DNS-SD statuses map to temporary_failure, narrower portable meanings win, and the exact native status is preserved
implementation.cancellation_deadline_acknowledgement: native completion, cancellation and a strict Dispatch deadline use the shared event sequence; the immutable hostname, address storage, task frame, DNSServiceRef and timer remain live until DNSServiceRef deallocation and callback/timer quiescence before exactly-once task acknowledgement

implementation.backend: non-blocking BSD socket establishment with Dispatch readiness sources; TCP and Unix stream payload through immediate nonblocking system calls and per-handle Dispatch readiness sources
implementation.descriptor_publication: FD_CLOEXEC and O_NONBLOCK are established before any descriptor enters a runtime-retained handle; connected and accepted TCP streams also enable SO_NOSIGPIPE before publication
implementation.start_failure_operand_preservation: implemented and failure-injected for task frame, handle storage, connect/accept/listener-close control, close deadline control, lazy TCP payload handle, shutdown request, consuming stream-close request, UDP queue/request/bounce storage and consuming UDP-close control; failed tcp_close or udp_close start leaves the named handle owner unchanged and failed UDP data start leaves the named array owner byte-for-byte unchanged
implementation.address_validation: v4 scope zero and v6 target interface index validation precede socket creation
implementation.listen_bind_submission: bounded socket, setsockopt, bind and listen calls run after successful task commit without occupying a blocking worker lane
implementation.listen_bind_cancellation: cancellation observed before native submission performs no socket operation; successful bind or listen is the non-cancellable establishment commit
implementation.listen_bind_deadline: the absolute continuous-clock deadline is checked immediately before socket creation
implementation.connect_submission: socket, Dispatch write source and optional strict Dispatch timer are reserved before task commit; connect is submitted only after successful commit and never blocks an executor worker
implementation.connect_completion: Dispatch write readiness is verified through SO_ERROR; successful native establishment transfers the nonblocking close-on-exec descriptor into the retained tcp_stream identity
implementation.connect_cancellation_deadline_acknowledg: the task frame, socket and sources remain live until every activated Dispatch source cancel handler acknowledges cleanup; one event-sequence-selected terminal outcome is published and becomes immutable before callback delivery
implementation.accept_reservation: the new tcp_stream storage, an independent listener retain, a FIFO node, the native request, Dispatch read source and optional strict timer are reserved before task commit; start failure leaves the listener queue unchanged and performs no accept
implementation.accept_submission: successful starts enqueue in per-listener FIFO order; only the head activates its Dispatch read source, queued deadlines remain armed, and accept is called only from head read-readiness handling; transient EAGAIN, EWOULDBLOCK or EINTR leaves the head pending
implementation.accept_completion: successful accept establishes FD_CLOEXEC, O_NONBLOCK and SO_NOSIGPIPE before publishing a newly owned tcp_stream and preserves the exact peer sockaddr returned by accept
implementation.accept_cancellation_deadline_acknowledge: native readiness, cancellation and deadline candidates use the shared monotonic event sequence; the listener retain, task frame, accepted descriptor, FIFO node and sources remain live until every Dispatch cancel handler acknowledges cleanup; the selected result becomes immutable before callback delivery, and only then is the node removed and the next ready head activated
implementation.listener_close_submission: successful task start consumes the listener and atomically marks its identity closing before returning; new accepts and address observations report closed; all FIFO accept reservations and active native requests are cancelled and acknowledged before the listener descriptor is closed
implementation.listener_close_cancellation_deadline_ack: close duties, descriptor release and the consumed listener release continue after task cancellation or deadline; an independently armed strict Dispatch timer rechecks the absolute mach-continuous deadline and records one shared event sequence at expiry; terminal publication waits for accept drain and timer cancellation acknowledgement, and a pre-existing close failure retains precedence
implementation.tcp_payload_handle: the first data operation lazily reserves one hidden duplicated-descriptor payload handle with read and write readiness sources under the tcp_stream mutex before task commit; stream storage owns the cached view and every committed request owns an independent retain through its terminal transition
implementation.tcp_read_submission: tcp_read reserves its complete request, deadline source and same-direction FIFO position before task commit; failed reservation preserves the complete named array owner and performs no payload I/O
implementation.tcp_read_completion: one read returns after the first positive payload progress, EOF or failure; the original array owner is returned with exact progress while untouched tail bytes remain unchanged; reads are FIFO by submission sequence and the output direction remains independently schedulable
implementation.tcp_read_cancellation_deadline_acknowled: native completion, cancellation and strict continuous-clock deadline use the shared event sequence; task outcome is immutable after first selection, while buffer, request, cached handle and descriptor remain live through the request terminal transition
implementation.tcp_write_submission: tcp_write and tcp_write_all reserve the complete request, deadline source and write FIFO position before task commit; failed reservation preserves the complete named array owner and performs no payload I/O
implementation.tcp_write_completion: tcp_write publishes success only after one positive native prefix; tcp_write_all continues until every byte is accepted or a terminal condition wins; every outcome returns the exact owner without mutating any byte and preserves positive partial progress
implementation.tcp_write_ordering: nonempty writes share one submission-order FIFO independently from reads; an empty buffer bypasses that FIFO and an expired deadline as a successful side-effect-free no-op
implementation.tcp_write_cancellation_deadline_acknowle: native completion, cancellation and strict continuous-clock deadline use the shared event sequence; task outcome is immutable after first selection, while buffer, request, cached handle and descriptor remain live through the request terminal transition
implementation.tcp_shutdown_submission: tcp_shutdown reserves the complete native request, optional deadline source, direction-specific FIFO position and independent stream retain before task commit; failed reservation performs no half-close, while an already committed direction succeeds without repeating native shutdown and before an expired deadline
implementation.tcp_shutdown_ordering: read shutdown follows earlier reads, write shutdown follows earlier writes, both waits at the head of both direction FIFOs, and the opposite direction remains independently schedulable; later empty payload operations retain their side-effect-free no-op result
implementation.tcp_shutdown_commit_cancellation_deadlin: successful native shutdown is the idempotent half-close commit and cannot be replaced by a later cancellation or deadline; storage state is published before later same-direction work, and the task frame, request, cached handle and descriptor remain live through native acknowledgement
implementation.tcp_close_submission: tcp_close reserves the cached payload handle, terminal close request and deadline state before task commit; successful commit consumes the named stream and atomically rejects later stream operations, while every start failure leaves that owner unchanged
implementation.tcp_close_terminal_cleanup: tcp_close cancels pending read and write requests, waits for their terminal transitions and the handle root cleanup, closes the original descriptor, detaches the cached handle and releases the consumed stream exactly once; cancellation, deadline and close failure never skip these duties, and a pre-existing close failure precedes an expired deadline
implementation.tcp_close_cancellation_deadline_acknowle: close completion, cancellation and strict continuous-clock deadline use one immutable event-sequence outcome; task acknowledgement occurs only after terminal descriptor and retained-resource cleanup, including when the task observer has already cancelled or dropped
implementation.udp_datagram_submission_and_ownership: udp_send_to and udp_receive_from reserve the task, independent socket retain, direction FIFO node, native request, optional strict timer and receive bounce storage before task commit; failed start preserves the complete named array owner byte-for-byte and performs no native datagram operation
implementation.udp_receive_buffer_contract: receive reads one datagram into independent bounce storage, commits only the received prefix into the returned array, leaves its tail unchanged and reports truncation exactly when the datagram exceeded the supplied buffer; native failure, cancellation and deadline preserve every byte, while send never mutates the array
implementation.udp_direction_ordering: sends and receives use separate submission-order FIFOs so each direction is serialized while the two directions progress independently; zero-length send remains one real native datagram in the send FIFO
implementation.udp_send_commit_cancellation_deadline_ac: native acceptance of the complete datagram is the send commit and cannot be replaced by a later cancellation or deadline; every terminal race uses the shared event sequence and retains the task, exact buffer owner, socket, queue node and Dispatch sources through native cancellation acknowledgement
implementation.udp_close_terminal_cleanup: udp_close consumes the named socket only after complete close reservation and task commit, rejects later operations, cancels and drains both direction FIFOs, closes the descriptor and releases the consumed socket exactly once; cancellation, deadline and close failure never skip cleanup, and a pre-existing close failure precedes an expired deadline
implementation.handle_retention: atomic independent references close the non-blocking descriptor exactly once after the final view or operation retain
implementation.unix_domain_sockets: R-SLIB-NET-0014..0017: Unix-domain listeners, streams and datagram sockets reuse the TCP listener, TCP stream and UDP socket storages and operation paths; a path converts to sockaddr_un before task commit, connect uses the same non-blocking connect source, accept publishes no peer address, a datagram send goes to the connected peer and a receive reports no sender; listen and datagram bind remove a stale socket file only on request, and peer credentials come from getpeereid and LOCAL_PEERPID

implementation.exact_program_invocation: posix_spawn with an exact executable path, argv, environment and captured-or-explicit cwd; no shell and no PATH lookup
implementation.start_failure_operand_preservation: command remains byte-for-byte ownership-equivalent after every allocator, pipe, Dispatch I/O root, spawn-attribute and runtime-stopping precommit failure
implementation.creation_commit: POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT plus POSIX_SPAWN_START_SUSPENDED plus POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGMASK with an empty mask plus POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGDEF for every signal whose disposition a std.signal listener replaced; the process lifecycle source and registry are installed before the event-sequenced SIGCONT commit
implementation.cancellation_deadline: task cancellation and a strict mach-continuous deadline may select only before creation commit; duties continue after selection and the first event sequence remains immutable
implementation.pipe_reservation: all requested parent process-pipe Dispatch I/O STREAM roots are created before task commit and remain child-owned until extraction or child drop
implementation.pipe_extraction: each allocation-free take atomically transfers one parent Dispatch I/O view under the process registry mutex; exactly one racing caller receives a configured endpoint, every unavailable state returns o::none and the extracted owner is independent of child destruction
implementation.wait_reservation: wait reserves the task frame, strict deadline source, exclusive observation slot and an independent native child retain before task commit; every start failure preserves the exact named child owner
implementation.wait_completion: DispatchSourceProcess performs the sole nonblocking waitpid reap and records one event sequence; success totalizes the wait status, while a pre-reap deadline returns the same retryable child owner and all paths wait for timer cancellation acknowledgement
implementation.terminate_commit: terminate independently retains the borrowed child, checks its absolute deadline immediately before bounded SIGKILL submission and treats native acceptance as a non-cancellable commit; wait remains the sole status observation operation
implementation.child_status_mapping: WIFEXITED maps to exited with WEXITSTATUS, WIFSIGNALED maps to signalled with WTERMSIG, every other Darwin wait status maps to other with the exact signed 32-bit wait status; success is true only for exited code zero
implementation.rollback: every failure after suspended child creation sends SIGKILL, cancels the installed process source if present and reaps exactly once before task acknowledgement
implementation.child_lifecycle: a runtime-retained child registry and DispatchSourceProcess reap every committed child exactly once even after the public child view is dropped
implementation.hosted_shutdown: executor drain is followed by child kill/reap, process-source cancellation acknowledgement and final Dispatch I/O pipe-root cleanup acknowledgement
